fusions.name: Scaffold Pounce
fusions.desc: Leaps 7 tiles to the target and slams the trowel flat, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Hopping Grit
fusions.desc: Flicks a pinch of quick-setting grit that deals 4 damage, then hops to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the enemy [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring and Brace
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles away and braces you: the damage you take is reduced by 20% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Mortar-Crusted Biter
fusions.desc: A fist-sized flea crusted in mortar fights beside you, striking for 4 damage; anything it hits moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
